_comment: Small-size US paper money, Series 1928 through 2021: what each issue was.
One row per denomination, series (year and letter), class and seal color.
app.classifier_defaults looks a note's class, seal, signatures and serial
prefix up here; see docs/specs/classifier-defaults-design.md. The loader
makes the table match this file exactly.
Facts only -- class, series, seal, signers. No Friedberg or other catalog
numbers, no values. Built and verified 2026-09-16: every row is backed by
at least two independent sources, named in `sources` --
wikipedia    'United States N-dollar bill' series tables and the class
articles (corrected where a second source disagreed:
Series 1929 FRBNs, the $10 Hawaii 1934A, $100 1969A/B)
uspapermoney USPaperMoney.info chronology and delivery-date tables
bep          bep.gov/currency/serial-numbers, Series 1996 on (all agree)
spmc         SPMC Bank Note History wiki, Series 1929 National Bank Notes
web          search-result summaries only (PCGS, Littleton, CoinWeek):
the six $500/$1000 Federal Reserve Note rows -- the weakest.
serial_prefix: the first serial letter of a $5-or-higher Federal Reserve
Note from Series 1996, from BEP's table only. BEP's footnote says $1 and
$2 carry none; its table's two rows saying otherwise are not copied.
signatures is null for the Series 1929 bank notes, which bank officers
signed.
